name: Anemone
author: Erin Carter
description: A single sea-anemone-like organism anchored off-centre in dark water — a ring of soft tentacle lobes built from polar petal SDFs, rim-lit against near-black with a dim warm core glow at its heart. Lobe colour blends around the ring through all four palette hues, desaturating toward the tips so it reads as one body. The whole ring flexes open and closed on a long eased breath, the contraction rippling around the organism while tips sway on a gentler secondary sine.

params.label: Breath speed
params.effect: Rate of the open/close easing cycle — the whole organism flexes faster or slower, with the ripple around the ring speeding up proportionally.

params.label: Ring radius
params.effect: Radius of the lobe ring in CSS pixels — the overall size of the organism on screen.

params.label: Lobe count
params.effect: Number of tentacle lobes around the ring (floored in-shader); few reads as broad petals, many as a fine fringed fan.
